subject: RFP: Pilot credits & scope — proposed stipend structure
messages:
From: Arielle Thompson <arielle@cloudapps.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@cloudapps.com
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RFP follow-up — pilot credits for multi-vendor bakeoff

Hi Karthik / Ben,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. We have an RFP timeline that puts a two-week bakeoff in the week of July 7. To make apples-to-apples comparisons, procurement has asked for vendor-provided pilot credits and a short SOW that outlines allowed test scenarios.

High level ask: 200k tokens of inference credits and two dedicated test instances (staging access) for a three-week evaluation window. Competitors are offering similar stipends — would Redwood be willing to match or propose an equivalent structure?

We care about latency at 95th, cost-per-call, and integration effort. If you can send a short pilot scope + agreement we can circulate with procurement.

Thanks,
Arielle
Arielle Thompson
Director, Technical Procurement
CloudApps

[Attachment: RFP-timeline.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 12:05:00 -0400
Subject: Fwd: RFP follow-up — pilot credits for multi-vendor bakeoff

Ben / Marissa — forwarding CloudApps' ask. They explicitly referenced competitor offers and want 200k tokens + staging access for ~3 weeks starting ~Jul 7.

My read: this is a high-potential mid-market account that could expand quickly if we show clear latency/cost wins. Proposal idea:
- Offer 150k hosted credits + 2 dev-stage API keys (isolated project) for a 3-week window.
- Provide a short pilot scope doc and an SLA for throughput during the window.
- Add a one-week extension clause (at our discretion) in case of scheduling slips.
- Require a short mutual action plan and joint evaluation metrics (we capture 95th latency, tokens, and integration effort).

Risks: competitor is offering 200k; full match eats into our promo pool. Suggest we offer partial credits + a small paid top-up option (e.g., discounted overage).

Can you weigh in on approval and whether we should route this to Markus for a one-off exception to policy?

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 13:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Fwd: RFP follow-up — pilot credits for multi-vendor bakeoff

Karthik — thanks for the summary. I support a pragmatic split: 150k free tokens + a 50k credit buffer that we can sell as a discounted overage or hold in escrow and only release upon positive milestone (e.g., integration test pass). That gets us closer to competitor offers while preserving some guardrails.

Operational asks:
- Need staging API keys scoped to a CloudApps project (no mixing with other evals).
- Ops will need a short runbook for expected traffic and a soft SLO. Could you draft the pilot scope doc?

Looping in Markus for an exception to the standard promo cap, if needed. If he approves, I can sign off on the credit allocation.

-Ben
Senior Sales Manager

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Jun 2025 09:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Fwd: RFP follow-up — pilot credits for multi-vendor bakeoff

Ben / Karthik — I reviewed the ask and Ben's proposal. I approve the 150k token stipend + 50k contingency model with the following conditions:

- Contingency (50k) will be held in escrow and only released after CloudApps completes an integration smoke test and signs off on the evaluation checklist.
- Karthik: include a one-week extension clause in the pilot scope and make clear that overages are billable at 40% off list if they choose to purchase.
- Ops/security: staging APIs must be scoped to a CloudApps-only project and rotate keys at the end of the pilot.

I've attached a two-page draft agreement that covers the stipend mechanics and acceptance criteria. Please review and tidy the scope language before sending externally.

[Attachment: draft-stipend-agreement.pdf (PDF)]

Marissa Cole
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Arielle Thompson <arielle@cloudapps.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Jun 2025 19:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: RFP follow-up — pilot credits for multi-vendor bakeoff

Hi Arielle — thanks for the details and timeline. We're happy to participate in the bakeoff and propose the following pilot structure: 

Summary (what we can offer)
- 150,000 hosted inference tokens credited to an isolated CloudApps pilot project in Redwood (usable for the 3-week evaluation window beginning Jul 7).
- 50,000 contingency tokens held in escrow and released upon completion of the integration smoke test and checklist (attached).
- Two staging API keys scoped to CloudApps with a soft throughput SLO; keys will be rotated at the pilot end.
- One-week extension option (subject to available capacity). Overages billed at 40% off list.

Next steps:
1) Please review the attached pilot scope and draft stipend agreement and confirm acceptance.
2) If accepted, we will provision the isolated project and keys and share a short runbook for expected traffic patterns.
3) Schedule a 30-min kickoff the week of Jun 30 to finalize test cases.

Attached: pilot-scope-v1.docx; draft-stipend-agreement.pdf

If this works, we'll also open a HubSpot lined deal and prepare a simple DocuSign for the stipend release terms.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
